01 — About

I build at the intersection of electronics, embedded systems, and software.

I’m an Electrical Engineering Co-op student at Concordia University with hands-on experience from academic projects and professional work. I enjoy turning ideas into working systems, from ESP32-based robotics and Arduino sensor projects to Python and machine-learning tools.

I’m comfortable solving both technical and practical problems, learning new tools quickly, and working with a team in fast-paced environments. I’m continuing to grow across embedded systems, electronics, programming, and engineering design.
